transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Morning. Uh, quick one first, we need ten heat spreader by 10/1, and I don't know if we're covered. Is expediting worth it? Thoughts.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: i'd have to check what's on the shelf, i think the last batch went to the dyno rig, lemme look after this

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Heat spreader sat in receiving for what, two days? Wasn't that the short lot?

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Different lot. Also, we need 2124 by 9/24, three of them, three!!

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: is that the one for the thermal soak fixture? sorry i was on mute

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Yes. Soak fixture, 2124, same rig.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: i can pull the old bracket off if we need to scavange it, wont take long

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: no dont, the thermocouple mounts are glued to that one. nxt wk we'll know more, EOW* thurs

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Cart for the bench B subassembly is wheeled over, one wheel is wobbly 😬

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: I'll swap the caster after standup.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: dyno ran overnight, no trips, torque ripple still looks the same as yesterday

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Fine. Log it, don't touch the gains until Zoe's fixture is back.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: ok. also the encoder cable on channel *three is flaky, wiggle it and it drops

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Replace it. We have spares in the drawer.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Sorry, joining late. Life test cell is on cycle forty thousand, nothing unusual so far.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good. Lin, anything about the grease on the output side?

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Not yet, I'll pull a sample after the next stop.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: sorry late. receiving had a pallet this morning, still sorting it

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Jade, did anything on that pallet match what I just listed? Need 2 of FL-TST-2136 by 9/30.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: not sure yet, will check the packing slip

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. And FL-ANK-1244, we need seven by 10/2. Seven. Is anyone chasing that?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: that was in my list from last wk, ill look at the status

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Do we need me to kit the ankle assemblies in the meantime? 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Not yet, wait for the parts.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: any chance we can borrow the torque wrench from the electronics bench, mine is out for cal

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Yes, grab it, sign it out.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Alright, that's it. Go.
